item: P1-51 PIN-confirm on money actions (SEC-04 scope extension; NOT the P1-50 permission matrix)
acceptanceBar: Re-auth (Admin PIN) must be demanded before a money/approval action COMMITS — approve/void/lock/reopen/close-day/close-month — regardless of session age (a logged-in owner still re-enters). Configurable + logged. MUST fail-open when no PIN is configured (never block a money action on a PIN-less install). Additive; offline; no new libs; does NOT touch storage-core.js/sqlite-store.js/photo-store.js.
existingCoverage: RE-AUTH PRIMITIVE EXISTS, UNWIRED TO MONEY: promptVerifyOnly(msg) at index.html:2208 — synchronous, prompt()-based, calls verifyPin, returns bool, does NOT flip admin mode. Exactly the SEC-04 re-auth primitive. Today used ONLY at setCurrentRole role-raise gate (index.html:2066); zero money actions call it.
verifyPin(pin) index.html:2192 (salted v2 50k-round hash + transparent legacy re-hash); hasAdminPin() 2198 = the fail-open pivot; auditLog(evt,data,before,after) available for logging each re-auth.

SAME-ORIGIN srcdoc iframes: shell comment 'direct ref (same-origin srcdoc)' index.html:3687; modules already call parent.SaagarEvidence and window.parent.postMessage — so window.parent.<fn>() is callable SYNCHRONOUSLY from any module. This makes a blocking prompt-based gate viable without async restructuring.

Existing bridge events ST_WA (index.html:6987), ST_SHARE (6986), ST_PRINT/ST_REPORT/ST_AUDIT (6979-6992) are all ONE-WAY fire-and-forget via window.parent.postMessage — they model an action, not a gate that must block-and-return a decision.

Money-action commit sites all follow the same idiom (read-only/role guard -> confirm() -> mutate -> save): payroll setRunStatus 3192/lockRun 3202/unlockRun 3234/closeMonth 3243; expense finishClose 1487 (shared by closeDay 1469 + closeStoreDay), voidEntry 987, approveDay 1493, reopenDay 1500, can('monthlock'/'monthoverride') 469/471; stock toggleLock 2218/doLockClosing 2340/submitMovements 2401/doReopenConfirm 2476; dsr submitDay 2731/submitAudit 2979/unlockForCorrection 3007. NONE currently re-auth.
Payroll actions already start with 'if(stGuardWrite())return;' — a proven single-line top-of-function guard slot to mirror.
Storage-registration surface already in place: appControlKeys() index.html:2149, APP_RE (factoryReset) 5818 auto-covers st_v\d+_ prefixes, restoreBlockedKeys() 2153, validateRestoreKeyValue() 5623.
delta: SHELL (1 function): add a synchronous global window.stConfirmMoney(label) that FAIL-OPENS first (if !hasAdminPin() return true), else returns promptVerifyOnly('Enter Admin PIN to '+label), and auditLog('money.reauth.ok'|'money.reauth.denied',{action:label}). Pure reuse of existing primitives — no new machinery. Build it as the single re-auth entry point (alias stReauth) so SEC-04/SEC-07 sensitive-view re-prompts reuse it instead of forking.

BLOB (1 line per site, mechanical): at the top of each targeted money action, right after the read-only/role guard and BEFORE the existing confirm(), insert: if(window.parent&&window.parent.stConfirmMoney&&!window.parent.stConfirmMoney('lock the pay-run')){return;}  — the '&&' short-circuit is the fail-open fallback when the helper is absent (old/standalone shell). Where a shared commit choke-point exists (expense finishClose 1487), gate ONCE to cover closeDay+closeStoreDay+mismatch paths and cut edit count.

Scope the wiring to money-affecting verbs only (approve/void/lock/unlock/reopen/close-day/close-month), NOT routine entry — matches P1-51's stated 'approve/void/lock/reopen'. ~12-14 guard lines across payroll/expense/stock/dsr blobs.

DO NOT build a postMessage VERIFY_PIN request/response channel: money actions are synchronous confirm()-then-commit, so an async channel forces every site into continuation-passing + a per-module pending-callback registry (MORE wiring + stale-callback bugs). The same-origin synchronous parent call is strictly lower blast radius.

Edits land in the EMBEDDED module blobs inside www/index.html via the existing embed pipeline; V:/Co work/Projects/Retail/_extracted_modules/*.html are the decoded read-mirrors (line numbers above are from those mirrors).
newKeys: NONE strictly required — the minimal build keys off hasAdminPin() and is always-on-when-PIN-exists, which already satisfies fail-open.

RECOMMENDED optional owner toggle: st_v2_money_reauth ('on'/'off', default treated as 'on'; still fail-open when no PIN). Name it with the st_v2_ prefix so APP_RE (st_v\d+_) and factoryReset auto-cover it. If added it MUST also go in appControlKeys() (index.html:2149) and get a validateRestoreKeyValue() rule (index.html:5623). It is config, not a secret -> appControlKeys(), NOT restoreBlockedKeys().

If a de-dup grace window is ever added (to avoid double-prompting on back-to-back actions), default it to 0 to honor SEC-04 'regardless of session age', and coordinate with SEC-04's existing ADMIN_IDLE_MIN_KEY — do NOT introduce a competing idle key.
lockoutHazards: P0 if fail-open is skipped: helper MUST return true when !hasAdminPin(). A gate placed before the hasAdminPin() check bricks EVERY lock/close/approve/void for owners who never set a PIN (P1-37 fail-open posture).

Version-skew brick: the blob guard MUST default to ALLOW when window.parent.stConfirmMoney is undefined (older shell or module opened standalone). A guard that defaults to deny bricks money actions on version skew — hence the '&&' short-circuit form.
prompt() Cancel returns null: must be treated as DENY -> clean return, never proceed. promptVerifyOnly already handles p!==null; do not re-introduce a truthiness bug.

Placement/atomicity: the PIN gate must run BEFORE any irreversible snapshot/mutation (e.g. payroll lockRun builds the frozen snapshot + advance recoveries; a gate placed after partial mutation corrupts the run). Cancelled/failed PIN must leave the record byte-identical, mirroring the existing confirm()-cancel path.
No session bypass: do NOT add 'if(isAdmin) skip' — SEC-04 requires re-prompt regardless of session age; a logged-in owner must still re-enter for money actions.

Device: prompt()-based verify on Android WebView is the established Wave-6 pattern but is still device-test-pending per memory — regress-test the prompt gate on-device before R0 sign-off; it adds one blocking prompt per money action (train users).
approach: Lowest-blast-radius design: a single synchronous, same-origin shell helper window.stConfirmMoney(label) (thin fail-open wrapper over the EXISTING promptVerifyOnly + hasAdminPin + auditLog), invoked by one guard line at the top of each money-action function in the module blobs — mirroring the existing 'if(stGuardWrite())return;' idiom. This works because modules are same-origin srcdoc iframes, so the parent call is synchronous and blocks exactly like the current confirm(), needing no async restructuring. Reject the ST_WA/ST_SHARE-style postMessage request/response channel proposed in the task: it is async and would force ~14 synchronous sites into continuation-passing plus a per-module callback registry (more wiring, not less, plus stale-callback bugs). Per-module blob wiring is unavoidable (button onclick handlers commit inside the iframe; the shell cannot reliably intercept them), but it is minimal and uniform (one line each; gate shared choke-points like expense finishClose once). Build the helper as the shared re-auth entry point for the whole R0-W1 wave so SEC-04 sensitive-view re-prompts and SEC-07 payroll/export re-prompts reuse it rather than forking parallel prompt machinery.
openQuestions: Exact site list: confirm the money-verb set to gate — proposed = payroll setRunStatus('approved')/lockRun/unlockRun/closeMonth, expense finishClose(close+closeStore)/voidEntry/approveDay/reopenDay/monthlock, stock toggleLock/doLockClosing/submitMovements/doReopenConfirm, dsr submitDay/submitAudit/unlockForCorrection. Include or exclude dsr submitDay (day report submit, not strictly money)?
Ship the optional st_v2_money_reauth toggle now, or hard-code always-on-when-PIN (simpler, fewer keys, no restore rule)? Recommend hard-code for R0-W1, add toggle only if owner wants an off-switch.

Attribution: SEC-02 wants the audit to name the PERSON. promptVerifyOnly verifies the Admin PIN (owner) — should money-reauth also record activeStaff()/named actor alongside the owner PIN, or is owner-PIN attribution sufficient for R0-W1 (named-user login is R0-W1's SEC-02 track, coordinate)?

Coordinate with SEC-04 owner: agree stConfirmMoney/stReauth as the single shared re-auth primitive so idle-lock re-auth, sensitive-view (SEC-07) re-prompts, and money-action re-prompts all funnel through it — avoid two teams shipping parallel prompt helpers.
Grace-window: SEC-04 says 'regardless of session age' — confirm we prompt on EVERY money action with no de-dup (recommended), accepting back-to-back prompts, vs a 0-default optional grace window.
